selection.selection_reason: An important-date pilot near the end of the 1990s expansion, with strong public attention to software, Internet infrastructure, online retail, and the coming year 2000. Not a random draw.

headlines.headline: The Fed raises its policy rate
headlines.summary: The Federal Reserve lifts its federal funds target to 5.25%, citing strong demand and tight labor markets.
headlines.selection_note: Shows the policy debate surrounding an ongoing expansion.

headlines.headline: Microsoft and the government make closing arguments
headlines.summary: The antitrust trial reaches closing arguments. Microsoft describes itself as a tough but fair competitor; government lawyers challenge its conduct.
headlines.selection_note: Prominent unresolved legal issue affecting a major software company; no later ruling is described.

headlines.headline: Amazon opens zShops to outside merchants
headlines.summary: Amazon introduces a way for other sellers to offer goods on its site, alongside new payment and shopping search services.
headlines.selection_note: Retail product expansion is salient on the cutoff date; no future success is assumed.

headlines.headline: Refugees remain at risk in East Timor
headlines.summary: International troops consolidate their presence in Dili while displaced people and militia activity remain urgent concerns following the independence vote.
headlines.selection_note: Include a major international humanitarian story outside financial-market coverage.

headlines.headline: Floyd brings flooding and power outages
headlines.summary: The storm floods highways and interrupts power along the Virginia coast.
headlines.selection_note: Reflects immediate everyday concerns, without assigning it a five-year market effect.

headlines.headline: Utilities rehearse for the year 2000
headlines.summary: A September 9 power-grid exercise tests preparations for the date change. Officials and programmers continue debating the risks of computer failures.
headlines.selection_note: Contemporary operational concern; summarize preparations without knowing the eventual rollover result.

headlines.headline: Dreamcast arrives amid gaming excitement
headlines.summary: Sega launches its new game console in the United States, drawing attention from players eager to try the new system.
headlines.selection_note: Consumer entertainment with limited direct relevance to the offered investments.

headlines.headline: Serena Williams wins the US Open
headlines.summary: At 17, Williams beats Martina Hingis to win her first Grand Slam title.
headlines.selection_note: A prominent sporting moment, not selected for later investment relevance.

macro.label: 1999 growth outlook: Q2 SPF summary, up to

forecasts.text: An August summary of the Philadelphia Fed’s second-quarter survey reports that 37 professional forecasters estimated up to 3.9% growth in 1999. This is an older growth outlook, not a probability of recession.
